dont_know: I don't know the answer to this from the approved guidelines. I have sent your question to your Development Agent (DA), who will reply to you.
dont_know_no_da: I don't know the answer to this from the approved guidelines. I have sent your question to an agricultural expert, who will reply to you.
hotline: You can also call the agricultural hotline {hotline}.
asked_for_person: I have asked your Development Agent to contact you.
service_unavailable: The advisor is not available right now. Your question has been saved and sent to your Development Agent.
banned_product: {product} is not an approved product in Ethiopia. Do not buy or use it.
unknown_product: {product} is not on the approved product list I can check. Do not use a product unless it is registered — ask your Development Agent.
approved_alternatives: Approved products for the same problem: {products}.
no_alternatives: Ask your Development Agent for an approved alternative.
poisoning: If someone may have swallowed, breathed in or been splashed with a farm chemical: seek medical help immediately. Take the product label with you. Emergency contact: {emergency_contact}.
safety_ppe_default: Wear gloves, a mask, long sleeves, boots and eye protection.
safety_children_water: Keep chemicals away from children, animals, food and water sources (wells, rivers, ponds).
safety_phi: Do not harvest within {days} days after spraying (pre-harvest interval).
safety_phi_unknown: Check the label for how many days to wait before harvest.
safety_reentry: Do not enter the sprayed field for {hours} hours.
safety_disposal: Never reuse empty containers. Rinse them three times, pour the rinse water into the spray tank, and dispose of containers as your Development Agent advises.
safety_poisoning: If anyone feels sick after contact with a chemical, seek medical help immediately. Emergency contact: {emergency_contact}.
placeholder_warning: Doses are not shown: check the product against the current EAA register, follow the label, and ask your Development Agent before spraying.
uncertain: I am not sure about this answer. Please check with your Development Agent before acting.
invalid_photo: The photo does not show a clear wheat leaf. Please take a new photo of one leaf in daylight, close up and in focus.
healthy_result: No disease was found in this photo. Keep checking your field every week.
uncertain_diagnosis: I am not sure what this is. Do not spray yet. Your Development Agent will check your field.
disagreement: The photo looks like {photo_disease}, but the weather and altitude at your farm usually suit {conditions_disease}. Because these do not agree, your Development Agent will confirm before any treatment.
conditions_out_of_range: Your farm's current conditions are outside what the disease model was trained on, so this result is based on the photo only.
conditions_used: This result uses your photo together with the altitude and recent weather at your farm.
general_advice_1: Walk through the field and look for the same signs on other plants.
general_advice_2: Mark the affected area and avoid carrying leaves to other fields.
general_advice_3: Take another photo in good light if the signs spread.
rain_wait: Rain is expected within {hours} hours. Wait until the weather is dry before spraying.
rain_check_label: Rain is expected in the next {hours} hours. Check the product label for how long it must stay dry after spraying.
follow_up_scheduled: I will ask you on {date} whether it has improved. Please send a new photo then.
follow_up_question: It has been {days} days since we found {disease} on your wheat. Has it improved, stayed the same, or got worse? Please send a new photo.
outbreak_alert: {disease} has been found on {farms} farms within {radius} km in the last {days} days. Check your wheat field this week.
cultural_practices: What to do in the field
no_registered_product: No registered product for this disease is in the database yet. Ask your Development Agent.
da_answer: Your Development Agent {da_name} answered your question: {text}
stage_reminder: Your {crop} has reached a new stage: {stage} (day {day} after planting). Open the crop calendar on your dashboard to see the tasks for this stage.
spray_rain_warning: Rain is expected at your farm in the next {hours} hours (from about {time}). If you plan to spray against {disease}, wait until the weather is dry, and check the product label for how long it must stay dry after spraying.
tg_welcome: Welcome to Agri-Stack 360. I answer farming questions from the Ministry of Agriculture guidelines, check product codes and send you alerts. Choose your language:
tg_share_phone: To use your farm information, tap the button below to share the phone number you registered with.
tg_own_number: Please share your own number with the button below.
tg_not_registered: This phone number is not registered on Agri-Stack 360. Register in the app, or ask your Development Agent to register you, then send /start again.
tg_not_farmer: This bot is for farmers. Please use the Agri-Stack 360 web app.
tg_linked: Done, {name}. Ask me a question (text or voice note), or send a product code to check it.
tg_link_first: Please share your phone number first, so I can use your farm information.
tg_help: Send a question as text or a voice note. Send a code like AB3D-EF7H-JK9M to check a product. /tip shows today's farming tip, /language changes the language, /stop unlinks this chat.
tg_stopped: This chat is unlinked. You will not get alerts here any more. Send /start to link again.
tg_photo: Photo checks are in the Agri-Stack 360 app for now (Crop Health, Photo check).
tg_error: Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again later.
tg_voice_failed: I could not understand the voice note. Please type your question.
trust_genuine: GENUINE: this code belongs to a registered product from a known supplier.
trust_reason_unknown_code: we do not know this code. The pack may be fake. Do not use it.
trust_reason_recalled: the supplier has recalled this batch. Do not use it; take it back to the shop.
trust_reason_supplier_suspended: this supplier is suspended. Ask your Development Agent before using it.
trust_reason_not_registered: this product is not on the registered list. Do not use it.
trust_reason_expired: this batch has expired. Do not use it.
trust_reason_possible_copy: this code has been checked more often, or in more places, than expected. It may have been copied onto fake packs. Ask your Development Agent.
trust_placeholder: (Product details from the MoA wheat manual; check the current EAA register.)
tg_no_tip: No tip has been published for today yet. Try again later.
price_where_near: at the markets nearest to you
price_where_country: at the markets that reported most recently
price_forecast_up: Forecast for {region} for the next 4 weeks: up about {pct}%.
price_forecast_down: Forecast for {region} for the next 4 weeks: down about {pct}%.
price_forecast_flat: Forecast for {region} for the next 4 weeks: about the same.
price_note: These are market reports (the average of the lowest and highest retail price). Prices change with quality and day: check at the market before you sell. A forecast is not a promise.
price_none: There is no recent NMIS price for {crop}.
price_not_covered: NMIS market data does not include {crop}, so I can't give its price. NMIS has prices for: {crops}. For {crop}, ask your Development Agent, your cooperative or traders at the local market. Whether selling now pays depends on the price you are offered and your costs.
emergency_fallback: go to the nearest health centre
tg_voice_unavailable: Voice questions aren't available right now. Please type your question.
lv_where_country: at the markets that reported most recently
lv_forecast_up: Outlook for the next 4 weeks{where}: up about {pct}% ({confidence} confidence).
lv_forecast_down: Outlook for the next 4 weeks{where}: down about {pct}% ({confidence} confidence).
lv_forecast_flat: Outlook for the next 4 weeks{where}: about the same ({confidence} confidence).
lv_reason_period: Based on {reports} reports from {markets} market(s), {start} to {end}.
lv_reason_no_season: Less than a year of data, so seasonal changes (holidays, dry season) are not included.
lv_reason_few_reports: Only {reports} reports: one unusual market day can move the result.
lv_reason_stale: The latest report is {days} days old.
lv_reason_checked: Tested on the most recent reports: off by {pct}% on average.
lv_reason_no_trend: On the most recent reports the trend was no better than assuming no change, so the outlook is 'about the same'.
lv_reason_not_checked: Too few recent reports to test the model on data it has not seen.
lv_reason_too_few: There are not yet enough repeated reports of the same animals to see a trend.
lv_none: There is no NMIS livestock price for {animal} yet.
lv_note: These are market reports per head (lowest and highest price). The price depends on the animal's size, condition and the market day: check at the market before you sell. An outlook is not a promise.
lv_reason_short_period: Only {days} days of data: too short to tell a trend from a passing change.
cited_dose_warning: Spray rates are from the MoA wheat manual (page cited). Before spraying, check that the product is in the current EAA register, follow the rate on the product label (the label is final), and ask your Development Agent.
abc_share_receipt: {org}: payment received, receipt {receipt}, {amount} birr. Shares issued now: {issued}. You hold {held} shares.
abc_share_due: {org}: {amount} birr is still owed on your pledged shares; the last day to pay is {date}.
abc_share_overdue: {org}: the deadline {date} for your pledged shares has passed and {amount} birr is still owed. Please talk to the ABC office.
